sites.title: Sites or sitemap URLs
sites.description: Website home pages (https://example.com) or direct sitemap URLs (https://example.com/sitemap.xml), up to 50. For a home page the Actor reads robots.txt for Sitemap: entries and falls back to /sitemap.xml. Only URLs on the same host as the site are checked. Only check websites you own or are allowed to test.

maxUrlsPerSite.title: Max URLs per site
maxUrlsPerSite.description: Maximum number of sitemap URLs to check per site (a cost safeguard).

maxUrlsTotal.title: Max URLs in total
maxUrlsTotal.description: Maximum number of URLs checked across the whole run.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Skip fetching pages that robots.txt disallows for generic crawlers (User-agent: *). They are reported as 'blocked-by-robots-txt' and are not charged. Keep this enabled unless you own the site.

slowThresholdMs.title: Slow response threshold (ms)
slowThresholdMs.description: Flag pages that take longer than this to respond.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Parallel requests per site (max 10). Each worker also waits at least 300 ms between requests, and robots.txt Crawl-delay is honoured, so the load on a target stays low.

onlyReportProblems.title: Only output URLs with problems
onlyReportProblems.description: Skip clean URLs in the dataset (they are still counted in the summary). Charging still applies per URL checked.
